name: P1：轻度二三次元融合·柔光
art: A subtle blend of photorealism and 2D anime across depth: the nearest objects (paving, railing, grass, the rock lip) have rich, almost photographic material detail and lighting; the middle ground gradually simplifies; the far distance (other islands, clouds, the sea far below) is painted in a clean 2D anime background manner with simplified shapes and gentle cel-like shading. The transition is smooth and barely noticeable - no visible boundary, the whole picture still reads as one coherent image. Surfaces are clean and well kept: no stains, rust, dirt, grime or decay; the railing is freshly painted, the walls are clean. Light: soft, bright diffuse light under thin high cloud, gentle shadows, a calm palette of soft blue-grey, sage and warm white with a few coral accents.
